reports.title: e.l.f. Beauty Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Updated Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: The Company is providing the following updated outlook for fiscal 2027. The updated outlook for fiscal 2027 reflects an expected 22-24% year-over-year increase in net sales, as compared to an expected 18-20% increase previously.

Previous Fiscal 2027 Outlook | Updated Fiscal 2027 Outlook
Net sales | $1,938-1,968 million | $2,003-2,029 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $401-407 million | $421-427 million
Adjusted effective tax rate | 25-26% | 25-26%
Adjusted net income | $212-215 million | $231-233 million
Adjusted diluted earnings per share | $3.50-3.55 | $3.82-3.86
Weighted average diluted shares outstanding | 60.5 million | 60.5 million
